sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:28

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:28:1
items.html: He caused an upper coupling in AVI: For when man raises MAN [female waters] to ZON, so too do ZON raise MAN to AVI [Aba ve Ima], and so do AVI to those above them, and so on still higher, ever upward, until the end of all the degrees. And then new Mochin arrive from Ein Sof by way of the degrees, until they reach AVI, and from them to ZON. For there is no renewal of light in the worlds except from Ein Sof alone. And always remember this.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:28:2
items.html: Other Mochin, which are the Hassadim and Gevurot of the Daat of ZA: As written in the Zohar (Mishpatim, page 502b), that the Reisha [head] of the King is corrected with Hesed and Gevura — only that the Hesed rose to Hochma and the Gevura to Bina, and the upper third of Tifferet, which is from the Chazeh [chest] upward, became Daat for him. And this is done through the Hassadim and Gevurot that he receives from the coupling of AVI [Aba ve Ima], as written further on.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:28:3
items.html:
The secret of the drop that AVI give in their coupling: You already know that the whole coupling of AVI [Aba ve Ima] face to face is by force of ZON, who rose to them as MAN [female waters] (as above, page 501, the passage beginning “the degree”; see there). And behold, before this ZON were back to back, meaning without the illumination of Hochma, except that they are corrected with the posterior of Ima, so that then they lacked no Hochma at all, as above. And this is the secret of “and their posteriors were inward,” for the NHY of ZON, which is their posterior, is not uncovered outwardly; because the posterior of Ima is drawn from the secret of the Bina of direct light before she emanated ZON outward, since at the time when she emanated ZON she had already returned face to face in order to draw the illumination of Hochma to him (as above, page 502, the passage beginning “and know”; study it there well). And therefore, since ZON too were corrected with that same posterior, it follows that the NHY of ZON as well are still included in their HGT, in their internality, and only the HGT is uncovered outwardly.
And after Adam HaRishon raised MAN to ZON, as above, these MAN caused ZON to find that back to back no longer suffices for them, but that they need to draw the illumination of Hochma; and therefore they too rise as MAN to Bina. And they caused Bina as well to cease her posterior and to couple with Hochma face to face, as above. And behold, then the drop went out from this coupling of AVI for the sake of ZON, meaning that illumination of Hochma which befits the NHY of ZON from their root in the direct light; and with this the lack of the NHY of ZON was filled.
And this drop of AVI clothes in the Yesod of Ima, which Yesod is clothed in the Tifferet of ZA down to the Chazeh [chest]; and it is the revealed Hassadim and Gevurot that go out of the Yesod of Ima from the Chazeh downward, that is, the new NHY that are included in that drop of the coupling of AVI, as above, in which there is the illumination of Hochma. And they are able now to be revealed outwardly, and there is no fear whatsoever of the shells, for now they are whole, without any lack. And therefore they are called revealed Hassadim and Gevurot. This is not so beforehand, when ZON were corrected in back to back; then these HB were covered and concealed in the screen of the posterior of Ima, in the secret of “and their posteriors were inward,” as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:28:4
items.html:
Hochma and Bina — their lights are not revealed in ZA, for they are clothed in the secret of Netzah and Hod of Ima: For the Mochin of ZA are clothed in the NHY of Ima, and the NHY of Ima are clothed in the HGT of ZA. The Hesed rises to Hochma, and the Gevura rises to Bina, and from the Chazeh [chest] upward rises to Daat. And behold, Hochma and Bina remained in the Rosh [head] of ZA, and they have no expansion into the Guf [body]; but the Daat of ZA, which is in the Yesod of Ima, has an expansion from the Chazeh downward, as above, and these are the new NHY that are now revealed in ZON.
And this is what he says: Hochma and Bina — their lights are not revealed, etc.; this is not so with the Hassadim and Gevurot that clothe inside the Yesod of Ima, which ends at the Chazeh of ZA, for from there they are revealed in complete revelation and go outward, etc. That is, as explained, that they are the NHY that are revealed outwardly because they received the illumination of Hochma, and their posterior was completed entirely.
